subject: Delay with the schedule adjustment
text:
Hi,

I want to let you know that the updated roster won't be ready by the end of the day after all. I started with the evening shift changes, but the supervisor asked for several corrections at once, so I moved those first. That pushed the later tasks back. I checked the queue after the changes and saw no conflicts for the rest of the week, so the adjustment should not affect anyone else's hours.

I have the morning and afternoon sections nearly complete. If it helps, I can send just those parts within the next hour. You can use them for the draft, and I'll attach the remaining edits after I've checked them against the original requests. The full file should reach you before the morning meeting.

Let me know if the partial version works for your planning.

Thanks
